sources.facts: ArcGIS item description calls the product RESOLVE Ecoregions and Biomes and describes 846 terrestrial ecoregions representing biogeographic/ecological assemblages. Exact selected ECO_ID and ECO_NAME feature geometries were queried and retained. Every assigned subject's recorded representative point lies in its baseline feature, the referenced pinned ADM2 feature and its referenced RESOLVE ecological feature; all 17 also match the named ADM1 parent by the representative-point screen.
sources.limits: No full polygon intersection/rebuild, complete ecology-to-location accounting, ecology-tier suitability decision, area remainder assessment or current ecological source comparison was performed. Point containment does not establish extent, exact clipping or completeness.
sources.recommendation: Engineering should replace the current administrative source_role and administrative selection_reason for all 17 physical fragments with an explicit ecological/physical-portion derivation. Preserve IDs, geometry, source member and parent; do not infer that this metadata correction approves their tier, full extent or parent.
